content: Annotated Meta Model Defines Applicable Variation Points If an association from {WholeClass} to {PartClass} is tagged with atpVariation , then any occurrence of {PartClass} may aggregate a VariationPoint . In other words, {PartClass} may aggregate Variation- Point even in cases where it is not at the end of an association that is tagged with atpVariation . However, using a variation in such a way would obviously not be compatible with the definition in the annotated meta model
